constraints.claim: The published 568/AAEL, 438/AACU and 528/AAFB keys are dated 30 April, 1 May and 2 May 1945, respectively, on Potsdam.
constraints.search_effect: Do not count these as three independent May 1 key nets or fix Thetis's rightmost rotor to VIII from their agreement.

constraints.claim: Kenngruppenbuch printed VIII, sections 26-28, distinguishes the key-net group from the procedure group and requires checking the current allotment list.
constraints.search_effect: The book alone does not date the target's key-net allocation or specify its machine settings.

constraints.claim: The Hering amendment label in copy 992 cites order MND IIc 2063/43 of 11 February 1943 and an amendment entered on 19 April 1943.
constraints.search_effect: The code word Hering is not by itself proof of a May 1945 allotment edition; compare the actual table, amendment and validity notice.

constraints.claim: Mahon reports deteriorating wheel-order rules in February-March 1945 and unrestricted Greek-wheel ring positions spreading to Bonito and Plaice in March.
constraints.search_effect: Older naval wheel-order and Greek-ring habits remain hypotheses unless a dated Thetis rule is found.

constraints.claim: Plaice introduced multiple Grund settings in March 1945; Mahon identifies 288 entries, selected by K-book row coordinates, and separate new Plaice and Dolphin tables at the beginning of May.
constraints.search_effect: Potsdam-to-Thetis transfer of MNNS or DGUG requires evidence that the applicable tables and coordinate mappings coincide.
constraints.unknowns: Thetis is not identified as using either recovered table on the target date.

constraints.claim: Mahon says the Grund tables were captured shortly after the planned May 5 bigram change; the subsequent surrender revealed fifteen bigram tables, with Grund tables due to spread further.
constraints.search_effect: Look for the captured-table report and its inventory; wartime capture does not establish that a Thetis table survives or is public today.
constraints.unknowns: No surviving table item, box or Thetis applicability has been located.

constraints.claim: The target's failed Potsdam trials reproduce the published MNNS and DGUG settings, but no consulted primary source equates its Potsdam and Thetis Grund tables.
constraints.search_effect: Keep an indicator-constrained attack conditional; do not remove unconstrained starts or rings from coverage claims.

constraints.claim: M.Dv.32/3 section 157 assigns Thetis to tactical U-boat exercises and specifies a 0700 DGZ key change, with Allgemein and Offizier sheets normally issued monthly; section 153 specifies a 1200 DGZ change for Potsdam.
constraints.search_effect: Separate key-sheet issue period from daily validity, and verify the target's time and the applicable amendment before choosing a daily key.
constraints.unknowns: Deckblatt 8's effective date and continued applicability on 1 May 1945 are not established by this reviewed copy.

constraints.claim: Copy 992's Hering Part B prints Thetis at columns 621-653 but crosses it out by hand; R.I.P. 401 Figure 14 separately dates a Hering list to 4 March 1945.
constraints.search_effect: Match the actual edition, amendments and date rather than transferring the allocation by its repeated code word.
constraints.unknowns: The handwritten replacement and its date are not adopted as a target key-net identification.

constraints.claim: R.I.P. 401 printed page 47 points to publication 475 for recovered or captured key-sheet contents; the RG 457 finding aid lists German Key Logs through May 1945 in Box 620, NR 1665.
constraints.search_effect: Prioritize locating publication 475 and examining the listed holdings; do not infer that they contain a surviving Thetis daily key.
constraints.unknowns: No consulted scan provides the target's Thetis key or Grund table.

constraints.claim: TICOM I-38 section 31 reports a December 1944 decision to use only two-turnover wheels at the right.
constraints.search_effect: VI/VII/VIII at the right may prioritize 126 of 336 orders; no order is excluded without establishing Thetis compliance on the target date.
constraints.unknowns: The report does not name Thetis, establish the target's settings or select VIII specifically.

constraints.claim: Team 6 records Z 29's books reaching Minden on May 8 without Flusslauf, followed by separate Flusslauf recovery on May 13 and dispatch on May 14.
constraints.search_effect: Use these capture events to locate item inventories; the recovered bigram booklet is not identified as a Thetis Grund table.

constraints.claim: Quelle copy 2499 repeats the inverse VA-to-KO and VR-to-ES pairs seen in publisher copy 1772; its cover requires a matching-number selection plan.
constraints.search_effect: Retain the existing indicator readings; two matching pairs do not establish whole-edition compatibility or the Thetis machine key.

constraints.claim: Mahon identifies Plaice as the expanded Baltic Laube/Potsdam key from January 1944 and describes Baltic U-boat re-encodings and repeated training messages separately.
constraints.search_effect: Interpret the existing Plaice Grund-table history as Potsdam evidence; Baltic location or a training subject does not identify a Thetis message or justify sharing its key.
constraints.unknowns: No reviewed passage provides a Thetis alias, target-linked plaintext or Thetis daily setting.

constraints.claim: TICOM I-11's original German account and DF-225's translation of a 1944 organization document assign naval-key production/distribution to IIcc under Pitzer; TICOM I-24 records Pitzer's June 1945 statement that 4 SKL II destroyed its retained back keys after reducing its records, and names Ob. Insp. Lier as compiler.
constraints.search_effect: Use the office and personnel names to locate captured registers and distributed copies; office destruction does not establish that every May Thetis copy was destroyed.
constraints.unknowns: None of the reviewed passages identifies Thetis, a May 1 setting, or an applicable common wheel-order rule.

constraints.claim: R.I.P. 401 Figure 24b depicts U-boat exercise traffic in the Baltic under the U-Uebungsschluessel, annotated as renamed Thetis in 1944, separately from the Eastern Baltic Potsdam/Plaice branch.
constraints.pages: printed 92, Figure 24b; PDF page 68 checked against the rendered original
constraints.search_effect: Include the older U-Uebungsschluessel name when locating Thetis records; do not infer a shared Potsdam daily key from Baltic geography.
constraints.unknowns: The chart's 1944 renaming annotation supplies no exact effective date, May 1 machine setting, allocation edition or target-linked plaintext.
